description: Create a fixed (non-editable) short link and QR on the signed-in Qorlie account. The destination cannot be changed later; scans still count on the account. This uses one of the monthly free (or plan) link slots. Use this when the user wants a hosted short URL and QR they will not need to retarget. Use create_dynamic_qr instead if they may change the destination after printing, create_static_qr if they need no account and no short link, and deactivate_code if they later want the link to stop working. `url` is the destination URL. `name` is an optional label. `idempotencyKey` (max 64 characters) prevents duplicate creates on retry.

idempotencyKey.description: Prevents duplicate creates or updates on retry (max 64 characters)

name: create_fixed_link
title: Make short link
